partners.diseaseBName: Congenital adrenal insufficiency with 46, XY sex reversal OR 46,XY disorder of sex development-adrenal insufficiency due to CYP11A1 deficiency
partners.mechanism_chain: CYP11A1 (HGNC:2404) —DISRUPTS→ Cholesterol (CHEBI:6775); Cholesterol (CHEBI:6775) —LEADS_TO→ Steroidogenesis (REACT:R-HSA-170995); Steroidogenesis (REACT:R-HSA-170995) —DECREASES→ Pregnenolone (CHEBI:27762); Pregnenolone (CHEBI:27762) —LEADS_TO→ Congenital adrenal insufficiency (HP:0003063); Pregnenolone (CHEBI:27762) —LEADS_TO→ 46,XY sex reversal (HP:0011197). Loss-of-function mutations in FDXR disrupt the mitochondrial electron transport chain and ATP synthesis, resulting in mitochondrial respiratory chain deficiency (Disease B). While the direct genes are distinct, both pathways are crucial for cellular homeostasis and their disruption can lead to overlapping cellular stress responses that manifest as distinct but related phenotypes.
